params.body:
Dependency round of 2026-10-07: every direct dependency on its latest version allowed by the constraints, and the open npm advisories closed.

## Security
- `shell-quote` 1.9.0 (through `concurrently`): critical, command injection in `quote()` (GHSA-pqg4-j6r4-53mv). `concurrently` pins `shell-quote` exactly, even in 10.x, so an `overrides` entry forces `^1.11.0`.
- `source-map-js`: high, event-loop DoS (GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q), fixed by the lockfile refresh.
- Both are dev-only (the `composer dev` script and the Vite build). `npm audit` and `composer audit` now report nothing.

## Updated
- `laravel/framework` 13.31.0 to 13.35.0, `phpunit/phpunit` 13.3.3 to 13.4.1, `larastan` 3.12.3, `phpstan` 2.3.0, `pint` 1.32.1, `nightwatch` 1.30.2, `phpspreadsheet` 5.10.0, `webauthn-lib` 5.3.9, Symfony 8.1.7/8.1.8 components.
- `vite` 8.3.3; `concurrently` 9 to 10 (major: needs Node 22 or later, which CI already uses; the flags in the `dev` script did not change).

## Worth a look
- `brick/math` went from 0.18.0 to 1.0.0 as a transitive dependency (through `ramsey/uuid` and Carbon). PHPStan and the suite pass; nothing in `app/` calls it directly.

## Checks run in the worktree
- `npm run build`, `pint --test`, `phpstan analyse`: pass.
- `php artisan test`: 667 of 668 pass. The one failure is `BuildStampTest`, which fails in every worktree and passes in CI.
params.title: Dependency round: Laravel 13.35, npm advisories closed
